description: Ministry of Labour - 17 Employees with Vs. Tea Small Holdings Development Authority
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the revocation and making of orders under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131, Acts No. 14 and 62 of 1957, etc.) and contains formal legal orders made by the Minister of Labour. While it mentions the Minister's name (Vidura Wickramanayaka), it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, and the core content is about legal procedures and regulatory actions under industrial dispute legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
